result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the licence and access rights to Affiliates and contractors, with a limited confidentiality condition. However, it does not address perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences, termination of subscription licences only for uncured material breach, or transfer to successors. Indeed, subsection (c) continues to prohibit all assignment and transfer, so the proposal reaches neither the preferred position nor the fallback successor-transfer position. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the Field of Use, payment, and other restrictions.
